argv:
E022: what became of 1401 stated needs, and the walk that resolved none of 434

Follows every one of E012's need statements forward -- the outcome variable no
failure in this record had read. 1401/1401 readable (gate A1 met), 812 answered
(0.580), 15/39 hand-judged served (0.385), 0/24 built by the requester. Gate A2
fires as declared before the first fetch: the depth-stratified lift is 0.703
against a floor of 1.0, so a trigger phrase does not mark a comment a thread
answers. Its interval spans 1.0, so 'answered less' is not established.

F042: need_depth_walk.py re-appended each chain's current node instead of the
node's parent, so no chain longer than one hop could close. It fetched 432
ancestors, resolved 0 of 434, printed 'no new ancestors' 29 times and exited 0.
1401/1401 depths now resolve. The reported odds ratio did not move (0.701 ->
0.703) because the two strata the arm uses were never affected -- knowable only
after the repair. tests/test_need_depth_gate.py holds the defective loop shape as
a failing assertion and reads the committed capture, not the walk's exit code.

D054: a harvested corpus is a population of statements until its outcomes are
read, and a candidate may not borrow a demand claim from the 'stated' cell.

Also removes three unresolved merge markers from tracked records (F013's shape,
which doc lint does not check for .md at the root), and the dead author join in
run.py that read Algolia's never-populated 'type' field and reported that nobody
built anything.

data.summary: Resumed E022 after an interruption and finished it. Repaired need_depth_walk.py (F042): it re-appended each chain's current node instead of the node's parent, so no chain longer than one hop could close -- it fetched 432 ancestors, resolved 0 of 434, printed 'no new ancestors' 29 times and exited 0. After the repair 1401/1401 depths resolve. Added tests/test_need_depth_gate.py (14 tests) holding the defective loop shape as a failing assertion and reading the committed capture rather than the walk's exit code; two of its assertions failed first because the test, not the code, was wrong, which is recorded. All six arms verify; results.json now carries gates A1/A2/A3, the three controls and the four limits instead of a pointer to the lift script. Removed three unresolved merge markers from tracked records and the dead author join in run.py that read Algolia's never-populated type field. doc lint, release check and 790 tests are green.
